findings.highlight: I lose the will and the desire to get back up
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち上がる意味も、意義も見失った
findings.governingReading: Shirou has lost both the meaning and the purpose or significance of standing again.
findings.explanation: The English changes a collapse of meaning into loss of volition and desire.

findings.highlight: My Holy Grail War ends here
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の聖杯戦争はここで終わった
findings.governingReading: Shirou states that his Holy Grail War ended here.
findings.explanation: The English shifts the retrospective completed ending into present tense.

findings.governingReading: Above all, Shirou goes beyond saying the war ended and denies that it ever began.
findings.explanation: The English changes emphatic escalation into correction, implying the first statement is replaced rather than deepened.
